partially_covered.missing: Organization attributes such as legal name, tax ID, contact details, or registration numbers are not modeled as data properties; only Address is present.
Item lacks data properties for description, unit of measure, product code, and related attributes.

cq_coverage.details: Most CQs are fully addressed through the class and property structure. However, CQ5 and CQ8 remain only partially covered due to missing data properties for organization and item details. No new CQs were left unaddressed, and overall coverage did not improve since last iteration.

strengths: Rich, multi-level class hierarchy with clear subclassing
Correct use of reification for N-ary relations
Functional properties and inverses well defined
weaknesses: No General Class Axioms for complex class definitions
No owl:equivalentClass axioms for necessary/sufficient conditions
Limited data properties for organization and item details

likely_oops_pitfalls: P4: Missing domain or range in some properties (monitor for future extensions)
P7: Missing disjointness between some sibling classes (e.g., AgentRole, Identifier, may need more explicit disjointness as model grows)

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Add data properties to Organization for typical business attributes (e.g., legalName, taxID, contactEmail, phone).
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Enables full coverage for CQ5 and richer querying of organization information.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Add data properties to Item for description, unitOfMeasure, productCode, and other relevant attributes.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Completes CQ8 and supports more granular item queries.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Introduce General Class Axioms (GCAs) to formally define classes like Buyer and Seller using role restrictions.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Improves reasoning and classification of participant roles.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Add owl:equivalentClass axioms for classes with necessary and sufficient conditions (e.g., define InvoiceMessage via its required sections and participant roles).
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Enables more powerful reasoning and validation.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Expand disjointness axioms to more sibling classes (e.g., AgentRole, Identifier, Price, Tax).
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Prevents logical conflicts as the ontology grows.

summary: The ontology remains structurally strong and compliant, with robust modeling of EDIFACT invoice structures and participant roles. However, key improvement suggestions from the previous review—especially the addition of data properties for organization and item details—were not addressed, so coverage and quality scores are unchanged. Further progress depends on implementing these high-priority enhancements.

suggestions_ignored: Add data properties to Organization for typical business attributes (e.g., legalName, taxID, contactEmail, phone).
Add data properties to Item for description, unitOfMeasure, productCode, and other relevant attributes.
